fields.label: App Title
fields.description: Shown as the heading of the cash book.

fields.label: Logo
fields.description: Shown beside the heading. Leave empty for the Hikmat Foundation emblem.
Cash in hand on the day the books started. Used only until the first daybook day is closed.
fields.label: Opening cash balance

fields.options: The staff who keep the cash book sign in at /rokar with the name and password set here — they never see this page. Saving this document creates the login if it does not exist, and resets the password to whatever is typed below.

fields.label: Login name
fields.description: What the staff type at /rokar. A plain name such as rokar is fine — it also switches on username login for the whole site; an email address avoids that. Leave empty to keep the ordinary Frappe login.

fields.label: Password
fields.description: Type a new one and Save to reset it. The site's password policy applies, so a dictionary word on its own will be refused.

fields.label: Accountants
fields.description: One name per line. Signs each voucher as Accountant.

fields.label: Approvers
fields.description: One name per line. Passes the voucher.

fields.label: Payees
fields.description: One per line. Vendors, contractors and people paid.

fields.label: Debited accounts
fields.description: One per line. Offered on the voucher's Debited A/c field.
